title: H Dept Weapons Control and Integration Prototyping and Fabrication
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVSEA.NAVSEA WARFARE CENTER.NSWC DAHLGREN
description_text: Please find attached Solicitation No. N0017826R0010 (Draft Solicitation No. N0017827R4402) in support of the Weapons Control and Integration Department (H Department), Naval Surface Warfare Center, Dahlgren Division (NSWCDD). This solicitation actively supports Naval, Joint, and national needs by providing design and fabrication, rapid prototyping, special acquisition, and technology integration related to circuit board design and Radio Frequency (RF) distribution assemblies, mechanical fabrication, fabric assemblies, battery assemblies, and mechanical and electromechanical assemblies. Please follow procedures identified in Section L for both questions about this requirement as well as access to the bid sample technical data package (TDP).
